# @gears-frontx/react

> React bindings, hooks, and components for FrontX SDK. Provides type-safe integration with React applications including MFE (Microfrontend) support.

Part of the FrontX React Layer (L3) - depends on @gears-frontx/framework. Peer dependency on react and react-dom.

## Core API

- [FrontXProvider](https://frontx.dev/docs/react/provider): Root context provider
- [MFE Components](https://frontx.dev/docs/react/mfe): ExtensionDomainSlot, MfeProvider (from `@gears-frontx/react/mfe`)
- Subpath: `@gears-frontx/react/mfe` carries the MFE context, hooks, components, MFE runtime re-exports and the MFE host plugin `microfrontends()` with its actions, selectors and state types; nothing the main barrel exports reaches it at runtime
- Type-system agnostic: no entry re-exports a concrete type system or declares an action or shared-property type ID; the host's type system defines them
- `FrontXProvider` resolves the shared `QueryClient` from `queryCache()` / `queryCacheShared()` through the app instance; mounted MFEs reuse the host cache by building their local app with `queryCacheShared()`, which joins the same shared `QueryClient` without mutating L1 contracts

## Hooks

| Hook | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `useFrontX()` | Access app instance |
| `useAppDispatch()` | Type-safe dispatch |
| `useAppSelector()` | Type-safe selector |
| `useTranslation()` | Translation utilities (t, language, setLanguage, isRTL) |
| `useScreenTranslations()` | Lazy load screen translations |
| `useTheme()` | Theme utilities (currentTheme, themes, setTheme) |

## MFE Hooks (`@gears-frontx/react/mfe`)

| Hook | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `useMfeBridge()` | Access MFE bridge (child MFEs) |
| `useSharedProperty()` | Subscribe to shared property changes, via `MfeContext` or an explicit `bridge` option |
| `useHostAction()` | Invoke actions on host application |
| `useDomainExtensions()` | Subscribe to extensions in a domain |

## Quick Start

```tsx
import { createFrontX, FrontXProvider, presets, useTranslation, useFrontX } from '@gears-frontx/react';

// One app per runtime, built once at module level (the full preset here;
// a host adds `.use(microfrontends(config))` from '@gears-frontx/react/mfe')
const app = createFrontX().useAll(presets.full()).build();

// Wrap app with provider
function App() {
  return (
    <FrontXProvider app={app}>
      <Layout>
        <MainScreen />
      </Layout>
    </FrontXProvider>
  );
}

// Use hooks in components
function MyComponent() {
  const { t, isRTL } = useTranslation();
  const app = useFrontX();

  return (
    <div dir={isRTL ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'}>
      <h1>{t('common:title')}</h1>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## MFE Patterns

### Using ExtensionDomainSlot

```tsx
import { ExtensionDomainSlot } from '@gears-frontx/react/mfe';

function LayoutScreen() {
  return (
    <ExtensionDomainSlot
      registry={registry}
      // the host type system's screen domain id
      domainId={SCREEN_DOMAIN_ID}
      loadingComponent={<Loading />}
    />
  );
}
```

### Using MFE Bridge

```tsx
import { useMfeBridge, useSharedProperty } from '@gears-frontx/react/mfe';

// LOAD_EXT_ACTION_ID and THEME_PROPERTY_ID stand for the host type system's IDs.
function MyExtension() {
  const bridge = useMfeBridge();
  const theme = useSharedProperty(THEME_PROPERTY_ID);

  // executeActionsChain is acceptance-only: it returns void, never throws,
  // and never yields anything to await for the chain's own execution.
  const handleAction = () => {
    bridge.executeActionsChain({
      action: { type: LOAD_EXT_ACTION_ID, target: 'screen', payload: { subject: 'other' } }
    });
  };

  return <div style={{ backgroundColor: theme?.primaryColor }}>...</div>;
}
```

### Shared Properties Without MfeProvider

`useSharedProperty(propertyTypeId, options)` takes an explicit `bridge` for components that never mount `MfeProvider`, plus a `fallback` returned until the host publishes the property (only `undefined` is substituted; a published `null` is a value). With `fallback` set the result type is `T`. There is no consumer-side validation option: the host validates published values against the property's schema before delivery, so `T` is the caller's declaration of that schema.

```tsx
import { useSharedProperty, type ChildMfeBridge } from '@gears-frontx/react/mfe';

function StandaloneComponent({ bridge }: { bridge: ChildMfeBridge }) {
  const label = useSharedProperty<string>(LABEL_PROPERTY_ID, {
    bridge,
    fallback: 'Untitled',
  });

  return <span>{label}</span>;
}
```

Omitting `bridge` falls back to `MfeContext`; the hook still throws when neither is available. Changing `bridge` or `propertyTypeId` moves the subscription and the value follows on the same render.

### Subscribing to Domain Extensions

```tsx
import { useDomainExtensions } from '@gears-frontx/react/mfe';

function ScreenList() {
  const screenExtensions = useDomainExtensions('screen');

  return (
    <ul>
      {screenExtensions.map((ext) => (
        <li key={ext.id}>{ext.title}</li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}
```
